answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed method with LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct on 3 different tasks: 1) Question Answering (QA): Nature Question (NQ), Trivi-aQA (TQA), 2WikiMQA and HotpotQA; 2) Summarization: Multi-News and GovReport; 3) Code Completion: RepoBench-P and LCC.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text for question answering, summarization, and code completion

answer_2.quote: We report F1 score for QA datasets, ROUGE-L for summarization datasets and Edit Sim for code completion datasets.

answer_3.quote: To further validate the effectiveness of AASD, we employ DeepSeek-V3 as a judge model to evaluate the relative quality of responses generated by AASD and autoregressive methods.
